scope: 11/16~11/20 표현 35개 중 14개 + 지난 오답 4개 + 2주 지난 표현 2개
grading_rule: 정답 1, 부분 정답 0.5(철자 한 글자·관사·시제만 틀림), 오답 0, 빈칸 0. 품사까지 틀리면 0. 영작(C·D)은 지정 패턴을 썼으면 틀 0.5, 패턴 뒤 절에 주어·동사가 맞게 있고 뜻이 통하면 절 0.5.
memo: 이번 주 표현 35개(단어 20·패턴 15) 중 단어 8개·패턴 6개를 날짜별로 고르게 뽑음(A8·B6·C4·D2). 지난 오답 중 11/14에 재출제하지 않은 address·receipt·dedicated·clarify를 B로 재출제(11/14 시험은 아직 채점 전). 유지율은 2주 넘은 reconcile(11/02)·breakdown(11/04).

questions.prompt: (결정·구매를) 뒤로 미루다 — put off / do later 대신
questions.note: 짝꿍: defer the replacement / defer the decision. 과거형 deferred(r 두 번).

questions.prompt: The auditor's first two questions have not been a________ yet.
questions.note: 문제·질문을 다루다. have been 뒤라 과거분사 addressed. address만 쓰면 부분 정답. 10/31 오답 재출제.

questions.prompt: "Given that ~, we will ~."으로 영작: 이번 달 주문이 적으므로, 토요일 잔업은 하지 않겠습니다.
questions.answer: Given that we have fewer orders this month, we will not work overtime on Saturday.
accept: Given that there are fewer orders this month, we will not have overtime on Saturday.
Given that orders are low this month, we won't work overtime on Saturday.
questions.note: Given that 뒤에 주어+동사(we have / orders are), 뒤 절은 we will + 동사원형.

questions.prompt: (직원이 쓴 돈을) 돌려주다, 정산해 주다 — pay back 대신
questions.note: 짝꿍: reimburse workers for ~ / reimburse the cost. 명사 reimbursement.

questions.prompt: Please c__________ the three small orders into one PR to save time.
questions.note: 여러 건을 하나로 모은다. consolidate A into B.

questions.prompt: (잘못·사실을) 인정하다, (받았음을) 확인해 주다 — say yes, it is true 대신
questions.note: 짝꿍: acknowledge the mistake / acknowledge receipt. 가운데 k, 끝 dge.

questions.prompt: Please confirm r______ of the new worker's health check papers.
questions.note: 수령. confirm receipt of ~. p는 소리 안 남. 10/31 오답 재출제.

questions.prompt: "The main reason (why) ~ is that ~." 패턴으로 고쳐 쓰기: Many new sewers leave early. It is because the dormitory is far from the factory.
questions.answer: The main reason (why) many new sewers leave early is that the dormitory is far from the factory.
accept: The main reason many new sewers leave early is that the dormitory is far from the factory.
The main reason why new sewers leave early is that the dormitory is far from the factory.
questions.note: reason 뒤 절(many new sewers leave)과 is that 뒤 절(the dormitory is) 모두 주어+동사.

questions.prompt: 해당되는, 적용되는 — for us / for this case 대신
questions.note: 짝꿍: not applicable to ~ / applicable law. 표에서 N/A = not applicable.

questions.prompt: (두 자료를) 맞춰 보다, 대사하다 — compare / match 대신
questions.note: 짝꿍: reconcile A with B / reconcile the accounts. 11/02 표현(2주 이상).

questions.prompt: "Under ~, the company is required to ~."로 영작: 노동법에 따라 회사는 매년 근로자 건강검진을 실시해야 합니다.
questions.answer: Under the labor law, the company is required to provide a health check for workers every year.
accept: Under the Labor Code, the company is required to conduct a yearly health check for workers.
Under the labour law, the company is required to give workers a health check every year.
questions.expression: Under ~, the company is required to ~.
questions.note: Under + 법·규정(명사), is required to 뒤는 동사원형.

questions.prompt: (직원) 이직, 이직률 — people leaving / quitting 대신
questions.note: 짝꿍: high turnover / reduce turnover. 한 단어로 붙여 쓴다.

questions.prompt: We need a d________ person to handle buyer audits full time.
questions.note: 전담의. a dedicated team / person. 10/31 오답 재출제.

questions.prompt: "My understanding is that ~. Please correct me if I'm wrong."으로 영작: 제가 알기로는 포워더가 통관 서류를 준비합니다. 틀리면 알려 주세요.
questions.answer: My understanding is that the forwarder prepares the customs documents. Please correct me if I'm wrong.
accept: My understanding is that the forwarder prepares the customs papers. Please correct me if I am wrong.
questions.expression: My understanding is that ~. Please correct me if I'm wrong.
questions.note: is that 뒤 주어 the forwarder + 동사 prepares(3인칭 -s).

questions.prompt: 항목별로 나누어 적다 — write each cost one by one 대신
questions.note: 짝꿍: itemize the costs / an itemized quotation.

questions.prompt: Could you c______ which team should keep the original invoices?
questions.note: 분명히 설명하다. clarify who / which / whether ~. 10/31 오답 재출제.

questions.prompt: "From now on, let's make it a rule that ~." 패턴으로 고쳐 쓰기: Next time, all visitors should sign the gate book. Please do this every time.
questions.answer: From now on, let's make it a rule that all visitors sign the gate book.
accept: From now on, let's make it a rule that every visitor signs the gate book.
From now on, let's make it a rule that all visitors must sign the gate book.
questions.expression: From now on, let's make it a rule that ~.
questions.note: rule that 뒤에 주어 all visitors + 동사 sign.

questions.prompt: (잘못된 것을) 바로잡다 — fix / make it right 대신
questions.note: 짝꿍: rectify the mistake / rectify the problem before payment.

questions.prompt: Please send me a b________ of the repair cost: parts and labor.
questions.note: 세부 내역. a breakdown of ~. 11/04 표현(2주 이상).

questions.prompt: "I'm not in a position to ~ until ~."으로 영작: 견적 두 개를 더 받기 전까지는 이 PR을 승인할 수 없습니다.
questions.answer: I'm not in a position to approve this PR until I receive two more quotations.
accept: I'm not in a position to approve this PR until we get two more quotes.
I am not in a position to approve this PR until I receive two more quotations.
questions.expression: I'm not in a position to ~ until ~.
questions.note: to 뒤 동사원형 approve, until 뒤 주어 I + 현재형 receive(will 안 씀).
